summary.text: Erin Maye Quade is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 56 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the Minnesota House from 2017 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Erin Maye Quade was born in Apple Valley, Minnesota, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of St. Thomas in 2008.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a nonprofit director.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Apple Valley resident and graduate of Greenleaf, Falcon Ridge and Eastview schools who is raising a daughter with her wife, Alyse.
Maye Quade represented Minnesota House District 57A from 2017 to 2019 and has represented Senate District 56 since January 3, 2023, succeeding Lindsey Port.
In the 2022 survey, she said she was elected to the House in 2016 as the only DFL candidate to flip a district from red to blue.
